item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】WAV - Victorious Cast feat. Leon Thomas III & Victoria Justice - Countdown (Alternate Edit) *FAN MADE*
item.description:
​

I've always loathed how the studio version of "Countdown" (on Victorious 2.0) removes most of Victoria's vocals from the song. Luckily, with the batch of TV edits we now have (posted here), I was able to try to create an edit more to my liking.

Let me state this outright: I am not a professional music editor and/or remixer. I have simple audio editing tools and did the best I could with what I possess.

I'm sharing this here because the majority of users have been kind and helpful, and I want to give back in some way.

If it's not your cup of tea, fine -- don't be a d**k about it. Just keep it pushing. To everyone else, I hope you enjoy it.

item.description:
Britney Spears - Britney: For The Record (Brazil Edition) [2008]



"'Britney: For the Record' is a 2008 documentary of American recording artist and entertainer Britney Spears. The 60-minute introspective documentary chronicles Spears' return to the recording industry after her much-publicized professional and personal struggles. Directed by Phil Griffin, For the Record was entirely shot in Beverly Hills, Hollywood, and New York City during the third quarter of 2008. Main shooting began on September 5, 2008, two days before Spears' appearance at the MTV Video Music Awards."

Brazilian official edition released in 2008 by Coqueiro Records.
With Portuguese subtitles.
